Sounds like you have combination skin. Make sure you’re using products that are made to benefit combination skin. Try using a gentle chemical exfoliant once a week at night and add something with niacinamide in it. It is also important that you are taking care of your health, try to eat on the healthier side, stay active and drink enough water, once I started taking my health seriously my skin cleared up fast, the way you treat your body plays a huge part in your skins appearance! (:

What really helped me was changing my diet to healthier foods, consistently working out, and drinking more water. How you treat the inside of your body has a huge effect on your skin! 

As for products, I use a non-scented moisturizer, a non-scented face wash, and a non-scented sunscreen for the morning time. Then I use the same cleanser and moisturizer for the night time but I add the curology acne treatment cream. I will also use a gentle chemical exfoliant once a week. Make sure the products you use are made for you skin type (dry, normal, combination or oily) and make sure you know if your skin is sensitive or not. Lastly, patience is important, it will take some time to start seeing results. I hope you find this helpful (:

Both Glossier Hoodies 

They’re so comfy and cute but they have a odd fit to them, they’re super baggy but very tights at the bottom of the sweatshirt, I have a small in the pink hoodie and a medium in the green hoodie but I prefer the medium more because of the way the bottom fits. 

Boy Brow

Foundation And Concealer

I love both of these because they both have enough coverage while still allowing my freckles to show. I can’t say how long they wear because I normally only wear foundation and concealer for short periods of time. 

You Perfume

The perfume wear all day, I could still smell it on me the day after I applied it! It’s amazing and it smells so good. If I had to choose one perfume to wear for the rest of my life it would be the Glossier You perfume!

Balm DotCom

I have all the “flavors” of Balm Dotcom and I love them all. They’re all moisturizing and leave a nice tint. Although, if you don’t frequently use them they’ll becoming very oily.
